- 2026-05-16 — Persistence: added `20260516200057_AddCertificateModeToCustomDomain` so `ProjectDbContext` no longer reports pending model changes after the custom-domain certificate-mode refactor; the migration preserves existing data by renaming `BindingType` to `CertificateMode`, remapping `SniEnabled`/`Auto` to `ManagedCertificate`, adding the new optional certificate metadata columns, and fixing the raw-SQL PostgreSQL quoting so Npgsql no longer hits `42601` near `\`.
- 2026-05-16 — Feature: CertificateMode — Replaced `BindingType` string with `CertificateMode` EnumValueObject (ManagedCertificate, KeyVaultCertificate, ManualCertificate, Disabled) across Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Contracts, API, and BicepGeneration layers. Added KeyVaultUrl/ManagedIdentityResourceId/CertificateName optional fields. ParameterFileAssembler maps CertificateMode→bindingType with resource-type awareness (Container App accepts Auto, Web/Function App maps to SniEnabled). All 2354 tests green.
- 2026-05-16 — CI: added `.github/workflows/mirror-to-azure-devops.yml` to mirror every GitHub branch/tag change into an Azure DevOps Git repository using `AZURE_DEVOPS_MIRROR_URL` + `AZURE_DEVOPS_MIRROR_PAT`, with queued concurrency and prune behavior so the target repo stays aligned.
- 2026-05-16 — CI: fixed the new GitHub -> Azure DevOps mirror workflow after invalid branch refspecs on the first run; branch discovery now uses `git ls-remote --heads origin` and every Git command hard-fails before prune, preventing partial syncs from deleting Azure DevOps refs.
- 2026-05-16 — Positioning: commercial assessment concluded the repo fits best as an Azure-first infrastructure modeling product centered on Bicep + Azure DevOps + MCP, rather than a generic multi-cloud IaC platform.
- 2026-05-16 — Feature: "View last generation" — added GET `/projects/{id}/latest-generation` endpoint (query + handler that lists blob paths without downloading content, returns categorized file maps per artifact type + timestamp), frontend button on generation-board empty state, workflow service signals, i18n keys (FR+EN). Handler optimized to extract timestamp from the same blob listing (no extra API calls).
